name: IMC Credit Services
description_short: IMC Credit Services operates a credit repair contact portal through APS Member Services. Limited public information available on their service offerings.
description_long:
IMC Credit Services is a credit repair company listed in the CreditDoc directory. The company's website was not reachable during our review, so we could not independently confirm current products, pricing, licensing status, or operating hours. This profile page exists so consumers researching IMC Credit Services can find the contact record on CreditDoc.

Because we could not verify the site, this page does not describe specific loan products, rates, or service details. Consumers considering IMC Credit Services should contact the company directly to confirm what services are currently offered and at what cost, and to request written disclosures for any product before signing.

Credit repair companies must comply with the federal Credit Repair Organizations Act (CROA). Look up the company on the CFPB Consumer Response Profile and confirm they don't charge upfront fees before signing anything.
